thread:
olivia: Quick handoff note — AcmeRetail has a scheduled load test tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'm OOO 08:00-13:00 PT, handing oncall to whoever is available. Key facts below, TL;DR: watch p99 latency, have fallback model & scale plan ready.

olivia: Test window: 09:00-10:00 PT. Customer will run ramped traffic 09:10-09:40 (scripted: 500 -> 3000 RPS over 15m, 30s steady at peak). Contract SLA: p99 <= 200ms across text-gen endpoints, 99.9% availability.

olivia: Current infra: Acme uses Dedicated pool us-west-2 (pool id: dp-acme-3). Model: rdx-large-v2-quant (serving config pinned). Canary rolled last night — observed p99 bump ~60ms at high concurrency in staging. Fallback plan: auto-failover to rdx-large-v1 (less optimized but stable).

raj: I can cover 08:30-12:30 PT. I'll keep an eye on dashboards and the autoscaler. Which metrics should we alert on if they cross thresholds?

olivia: Good, thanks. Alerts I'd use: 
- latency_p99 > 220ms for 2m (page)
- error_rate > 0.5% for 5m (page)
- queue_depth > 50 for 1m (pager)
Links: <https://console.redwood/dashboards/acme|Acme dashboard>, runbook: <https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/acme|runbook>.

kevin: I'll be on standby for infra escalations. If autoscaler fails to add nodes, ping me @kevin and I'll ssh into the pool. My pager: +1-555-0132.

maya: FYI from AE: stakeholders will validate correctness at 09:20; they'll abort at first sign of >200ms p99. We'll send a formal notice to their ops channel before starting.

raj: Quick ops commands (copy if needed):
```
# check inference pods for Acme pool
kubectl get pods -n dedicated-acme-3 | grep inference
# watch p99 from metrics API (1m window)
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/query?metric=latency_p99&pool=dp-acme-3" | jq .value
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rdx-large-v2-quant -> dp-acme-3 completed at 1798680000. Canary passed smoke tests; note: low sample at peak.

raj: If you see p99 creeping up, flip service to fallback via quick rollback: `rdctl rollout set dp-acme-3 --model rdx-large-v1` (should be ~2-4 min to take effect). I can perform if needed.

olivia: Small checklist before handoff (please ack):
- [ ] Verify runbook link + contact list (done?)
- [ ] Confirm autoscaler min replicas >= 2 (currently 2)
- [ ] Confirm burst capacity enabled (confirmed)
- [ ] Make sure tracing is on for Acme routes

kevin: Acked on contacts and burst capacity. I'll monitor node provisioning ETA at 08:50 PT.

maya: I'll DM the customer ops channel to confirm start time and abort criteria.

raj: I'll stay in channel at 08:30 and can take rollback if needed.

olivia: Thanks all — leaving the thread pinned for the handoff. If anything changes before 09:00 PT I'll post here. :thumbsup:
